Nov 13, 2026, 07:30 ET


**Teleconference and Webcast to be held on November 17, 2026**


PRINCETON, N.J.


, Nov. 13, 2026


/PRNewswire/ — Palatin Technologies, Inc. (Nasdaq:PTN ) will announce its first quarter fiscal year 2027 operating results on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, before the open of the U.S. financial markets.


Palatin will also conduct a conference call and live audio webcast hosted by its executive management team on November 17, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. ET. The conference call will provide an update on corporate and development activities.

**About Palatin**


Palatin Technologies, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company developing medicines targeting the melanocortin receptor system. Palatin’s principal strategic development focus is advancing next-generation MC4R-selective agonists for rare neuroendocrine obesity disorders, including hypothalamic obesity, Prader-Willi syndrome and Bardet-Biedl syndrome. The Company is developing long-acting injectable peptide agonists, oral small-molecule agonists and an oral peptide agonist approach, with the objective of delivering differentiated efficacy, tolerability and dosing profiles suitable for long-term treatment. Palatin also utilizes collaborations, licensing arrangements and strategic partnerships to advance other melanocortin-based programs. For more information, visit[www.palatin.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4821863-1&h=1304508067&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.palatin.com%2F&a=www.palatin.com) .
